info.title: Wuling HTTP API
info.description: Browser requests use HttpOnly cookies. All writes require the exact configured WULING_WEB_ORIGIN in Origin. PATs only authorize repository reads. Historical collaboration writes return 503. IDs are PostgreSQL int64; JavaScript consumers must reject values outside the safe integer range.
